apps.sdkOfficialGitDesc: The SDK resides at sdk/rust in the Sonde repo and has publish = false (not published to crates.io). Token refresh, HMAC, nonce, heartbeat, background batching, and optional crash-persistent WAL are all handled internally by the SDK.
apps.sdkFactDeviceIdDesc: SDK creates and persists high-entropy installation/device ID on first launch; business telemetry does not send anonymousId.
apps.sdkFactTimeSessionDesc: Clients do not upload timestamp/sessionId. Sonde derives them using server receipt time, heartbeat, and activity gaps.
apps.sdkFactReliableDesc: Optional WAL appends + fsyncs before async enqueue succeeds; data crashed before server ACK will recover on next startup.
apps.sdkGuidance: Store sonde-device-id and sonde-spool in your application's own persistent data directory. WAL uses at-least-once delivery; crucial business events should set a stable idempotency_key. When an existing identity file is corrupted, the SDK errors rather than switching IDs automatically. In production, consider adding rev = "<commit sha>" in Git dependency to pin the SDK version. New Ingest Keys use the ingest scope.
apps.ingestScopeFixed: Fixed scope: ingest (heartbeat + events + metrics + logs + errors)

activity.title: Activity & Cumulative Behavior
activity.subtitle: Active duration and sessions are derived strictly from trusted server-observed activity intervals. Historical imports only count active devices without extrapolating duration.
activity.coverageHint: Average active time samples only devices with trusted consecutive intervals; current coverage is {{pct}}%.
backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: Streamed archive migration for complete instances, avoiding high memory overhead on large telemetry datasets.
backup.exportDesc: Server streams consistent database snapshot with primary-key pagination as NDJSON lines, never buffering full-database JSON in memory.
backup.runtimeStateDesc: Sessions / replay / leases / dirty markers not exported
backup.securityNotice: Archives contain password hashes and webhook credentials, protect as secret material. TOTP seeds are intentionally excluded; re-enroll 2FA after restore.
backup.restoreDesc: Browser only inspects the first manifest line. The server asynchronously stages and validates the entire archive, then replaces data atomically in a single transaction.
backup.restoreWarning: Full restore replaces existing data: current users, applications, telemetry, alerts, and audit logs will be replaced. Sessions and leases will be cleared.
backup.notSondeBackup: File is not a valid Sonde full backup.
backup.confirmRestore: Confirm full system restore? Existing data will be replaced in a single transaction and your current session will expire.
backup.restoreSuccess: Restore complete: wrote {{count}} records. Auth reset, redirecting to login.
